narrative.overview:
KeelDesk is a Windows 11-native MCP runtime daemon and developer environment workbench engineered with the austere, high-density clarity of Cursor and Vercel. Every screen operates inside a viewport-locked 100dvh desktop frame (overflow: clip) fused seamlessly to the native Win32 DWM dark caption bar. Rather than competing for attention with decorative gradients, heavy drop shadows, or spacious marketing cards, the interface recedes into crisp graphite-black surfaces, 1px translucent hairlines, and aligned monospace telemetry—surfacing visual urgency only when a ConfirmRequired safety gate demands human judgment.

Structural consistency across typography, spacing, and concentric corner radii is the backbone of the system. Every text node maps to one of six fixed desktop type roles; every margin, gap, and cell gutter locks onto a 4px base grid aligned to a unified 12px panel plumb line; and every nested container steps down concentrically in 2px radius increments (12px -> 10px -> 8px -> 6px -> 4px).
keyCharacteristics: Dark-Only Win11 DWM Fusion: Single-track graphite dark palette locked pixel-for-pixel to Win32 DWMWA_CAPTION_COLOR (#111116), paired with Windows High Contrast (forced-colors) fallbacks.
Unified Six-Role Desktop Type Scale: Fixed rem steps (18 / 15 / 13 / 12 / 11px + 12px mono code) tuned for 100%–200% Windows 11 desktop scaling with tabular-nums discipline.
12px Vertical Plumb-Line Rhythm: 4px base grid with unified 12px (spacing.md) panel chrome padding so headers, filter bars, table columns, and footers share one unbroken vertical axis.
Concentric 2px Corner Geometry: Strict five-tier corner hierarchy from 12px modals down to 4px technical chips.
State-Only Chromatic Signal: 95% monochrome graphite and Crisp White/Slate ink; Keel Indigo (<=5%) marks primary focus, while semantic status hues appear exclusively on live telemetry states.

rules.name: The DWM Pixel-Lock Rule
rules.body: surface-canvas must remain #111116 at all times to match DWMWA_CAPTION_COLOR (0x00161111) in src-tauri/src/win11.rs. Changing one without the other breaks the native window illusion and is forbidden.

rules.name: The Monochrome 95% Rule
rules.body: At rest, at least 95% of the viewport must remain monochrome graphite and neutral ink. Keel Indigo is capped at <=5% of screen area; never tint entire card backgrounds or decorative headers with brand color.

rules.name: The Six-Step Type Floor Rule
rules.body: Every text element must use one of the six semantic tokens (text-title-lg, text-title, text-body, text-caption, text-micro, text-code). Arbitrary bracketed pixel utilities (text-[10px], text-[11px], text-[0.8rem]) and fluid web clamp() scales are strictly prohibited; 11px (0.6875rem) is the absolute legibility floor.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every port (:19527), PID, latency (2 ms), counter, timestamp (14:08:32), and approval countdown (58s) must render in --font-mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so live updates never cause horizontal layout jitter.

rules.name: The Hairline-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Resting workbench containers never cast drop shadows and never nest cards inside cards. Inner grouping inside a panel uses sunken #0b0b0f wells (CodeWell) or 1px border-subtle dividers.

rules.name: The Semantic Z-Index Rule
rules.body: Stacking contexts use exclusively the semantic scale (sticky: 10, dropdown: 30, drawer: 40, modal: 50, toast: 60, tooltip: 70). Arbitrary values like z-[999] are forbidden.

dos: Do lock html, body, #root and the root workbench shell to 100dvh with overflow: clip, placing min-h-0 min-w-0 on every nested Flex/Grid/Tabs track and wrapping scrollable regions in <ScrollArea>.
Do align CardHeader, toolbar strips, outer TableHead/TableCell padding, and CardFooter on the unified 12px (px-3) horizontal plumb line.
Do follow the concentric 2px radius step-down (12px modal -> 10px card -> 8px well/alert -> 6px button/input -> 4px badge/kbd).

Do use exclusively the six semantic typography utilities (text-title-lg, text-title, text-body, text-caption, text-micro, text-code) and apply font-mono tabular-nums to all ports, PIDs, durations, and counters.
Do wrap truncated paths, versions, and descriptions in <TruncatedText> (keyboard-focusable Radix <Tooltip> with aria-hidden="true" duplicate suppression) rather than native title attributes.
Do synchronize index.html's inline #keel-critical-boot skeleton colors and radii whenever canvas or panel tokens change.
donts: Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text), neon AI glows, or decorative glassmorphism across workbench panels.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders (border-left or border-right greater than 1px) on alerts, rows, or cards.
Don't use spacious SaaS marketing hero cards, bubbly rounded-full text badges, or bounce/elastic motion curves.
Don't introduce browser-style page scrollbars, custom HTML Min/Max/Close window buttons, or uncalibrated light-mode tokens that break the #111116 Win32 DWM titlebar fusion.
Don't write arbitrary font sizes (text-[10px], text-[11px], clamp()), arbitrary rounded-[min(...)] corner formulas, or space-x-* / space-y-* margin utilities.
Don't nest <Card> inside <Card>; use sunken #0b0b0f wells (<CodeWell>) or 1px hairlines for inner structure.
